author: gingus2611
body:
https://www.dropbox.com/sh/x6mi55cv99q9ou3/AACJzX5-asPeFXBohfJlQk6_a
This is a map me and Bink26 made. I think it's pretty unique to Avicus and would be a good map for Nexus, Please give feedback and advice so we can improve! The theme of the map is towers, with the primary blocks being cobblestone and stone.

http://gingus2611.imgur.com/all/ for screenshots.

Haven't sorted out the YAML yet but it would be called Turres, and would probably 10-20 minutes long.
Please comment if you have experience in YAML as I'm not very good at using it :(
